title: Keep request drafts across result navigation without retaining execution authority
summary: Preserve unfinished launcher inputs in view-local memory while remounting readiness and recovery checks; discard drafts on route-context changes.
reusable_steps: Preserve unfinished launcher inputs in view-local memory while remounting readiness and recovery checks; discard drafts on route-context changes
expected_outcome: When a request launcher unmounts to show a result, keep only its user-entered goal and selections in the parent view. Use one volatile draft, not a per-tenant cache or persistent browser storage. Bind retention to all raw route scope selectors and the full linked request; exclude result-room and read-only navigation flags. Observe router replacements and browser history. Clear the entire draft immediately when context changes and explain why; never reseed an old URL goal into a new scope. Check the live URL again before edits or submission. Keep execution-readiness and durable create-receipt recovery in remounting children so restored text does not restore permission, stale readiness or automatic execution. Clearing a draft must not clear an unconfirmed request marker. Test actual open/back/forward events, scope changes, stale submit races and nonempty drafts blocked by unknown receipts. Explicitly distinguish React DOM interaction verification from rendered-browser or live-provider verification. For real result revision, introduce an authorized source-room contract rather than labelling a copied initial goal as a revision.
